# ToastOptions

type ToastOptions = {
  message: string
  description?: string
  variant?: 'info' | 'success' | 'error'
  /** Milliseconds; zero keeps the notification until dismissed. */
  duration?: number
  /** Makes the whole notification clickable. Clicking it or its action button runs `run`, then closes it. */
  action?: ToastAction
}
